result.title: STRATA: Self-Maintaining Structured Experience Graphs for Self-Evolving Language Agents
result.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve at test time by accumulating experience: retrieving relevant memories before acting and writing new lessons back afterwards. Yet most are single-level: trajectories, distilled workflows and reasoning items all land in one undifferentiated pool indexed by embedding similarity, with no typed abstraction hierarchy. They never forget or deduplicate, and are prone to negative transfer, where a superficially similar but directionally opposite experience is recalled and its concrete steps are copied verbatim, actively harming the agent. We introduce STRATA, a structured, outcome-grounded, self-maintaining memory that organizes experience into a three-layer graph of atomic skills and code snippets, task workflows and generalized meta-frameworks, connected by typed edges. STRATA maintains itself through five mechanisms sharing one similarity geometry: a multi-dimensional similarity that scores retrieval by operation and target; a typed reflector crystallizing procedures from successes and pitfalls from failures; community detection that induces meta-frameworks; pressure-triggered garbage collection with articulation-point protection; and contrast edges that flag confusable, direction-opposite experiences. Across four interactive benchmarks (AppWorld, WebArena, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld), two frozen backbones and seven baselines, STRATA attains the best average score while simultaneously using the lowest latency and fewest environment steps of any memory-augmented method, and 44% fewer lines of injected memory than the most context-hungry baseline. We isolate two failure modes of prior memories: single-level memory degrades sharply as the task set grows, and single-level concrete memories suffer catastrophic negative transfer, which contrast edges repair, lifting ScienceWorld from 78.7 to 96.7 within the same system.

AI.brief_summary: STRATA 为自进化 LLM agent 提出三层类型化经验图记忆，用多维相似度检索、类型化反射器、社区检测、压力触发的垃圾回收与对比边五种机制自维护，并在四个交互基准、两个冻结骨干与七个基线对比中取得最佳平均分与最低延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按操作与目标」的多维相似度几何及标记方向相反经验的对比边，可能为 LVR 中潜在状态的相似检索、误导性轨迹复用与负迁移抑制提供可核查的方法线索，但原文面向纯文本 agent 记忆、无视觉或 latent 推理验证。
